subject: Transportation Systems
title: Stockholm's Art Gallery
description: A 60-second lesson on Stockholm's Art Gallery.

hook.text: Stockholm calls its metro 'the world's longest art gallery.' Over 90 stations feature original art.

buildup.text: Artists painted directly on exposed bedrock, creating cave-like murals deep underground.

discovery.text: Each station is a unique installation—rainbow ceilings, sculptured arches, and surreal landscapes.

twist.text: The art was controversial in the 1950s. Critics called it a waste of public money.

climax.text: Today it's Stockholm's most visited cultural attraction—seen by more people than any museum.

punchline.text: The best gallery is one you ride through every day.

quiz.question: How many Stockholm metro stations feature original artwork?
